lines: Here's a small plan for today.
Walk at a brisk pace for 20 minutes, quick enough that talking takes a little effort.
Try adding some protein to each meal, like eggs, beans, yogurt or fish. If your doctor has told you to limit protein, follow that.
Try going to bed and getting up at the same time each day, and get some daylight in the morning.
Nice to hear from you. How have you been?

items.title: Some protein at each meal
